description: The connected person's own order history at WaitApp venues, newest first. Each order has its venue, code, status, total, type, when it was placed and what was ordered: every item with its quantity, price and chosen choices. Items carry menuItemId and selectedOptions in the form draft_delivery_order accepts. Deliveries also show the address, delivery fee and stage. A kitchen and a bar order placed together are one entry. Filter by venue, status, text (an item or venue name) or date, and page back with nextBefore. Only this person's own orders are returned.

before.description: Only orders placed before this time. Pass nextBefore from the previous page

query.description: An item name or venue name, e.g. burger or Social

since.description: Only orders placed on or after this date, e.g. 2026-09-01

status.description: e.g. pending, accepted, preparing, ready, served, cancelled

name: list_my_orders
title: List my orders
